All PTZOptics cameras share the same VISCA-over-IP command set on TCP 5678. Older models may not support every command (the camera ignores unknown ones). 12X-USB needs PTZOptics' IP/serial bridge for network control.

The full RoboSHOT family shares one Telnet API. Vaddio is now part of Legrand AV — older boxes still ship as "Vaddio". ConferenceShot models predate the rename and use an older firmware revision but the same command shape. Speed ranges (pan 1-24, tilt 1-20, zoom 1-7, focus 1-8) and CCU value ranges are consistent across the family.
